def load_patients(db_path, data):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    for row in data:
        age_category = 'Adult' if row['age'] >= 18 else 'Minor'
        cursor.execute('INSERT INTO processed_patients (id, age_category) VALUES (?, ?)', (row['id'], age_category))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
